description: Exact path-based exceptions for ops/scripts/validate_memory_egress_boundary.py. Every entry names the campaign stage that deletes it and an expiry date; an expired entry is a finding. Nothing here authorizes new provider egress — it inventories the legacy bypass the realignment campaign removes (CURSOR_GOVERNANCE_MEMORY_CONTROL_PLANE_REALIGNMENT_BUILD_PLAN §8).

Stages C7-C10 retired the MCP front door, the Claude adapter, the Cursor gate hooks, the secret plane, the distill worker and the generated-data ingress: those entries are gone and any new finding there is unlisted.
